CustomField.description: The sheet's columns, in order, separated by commas or new lines. Each is a field API name or a path through lookups (Account.Owner.Name). The header is the field's label unless one is given with AS: "Owner.Name AS Account Owner". Fields the running user cannot see are left out.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Columns in order, comma or line separated. e.g. "Name, Industry, Owner.Name AS Owner, CreatedDate"
CustomField.label: Fields
